text: Place a glass of water beside your bed tonight. Tomorrow morning, you will understand why. This is one of the oldest practices that exist. Simple, silent and revealing. Before you sleep, fill a clear glass with clean water. Hold it with both hands. Close your eyes and say quietly, While I rest, cleanse what I cannot see. Absorb what is heavy. Remove what is not mine. You are giving the water an instruction. You are telling it what to do while you sleep. Water is the most receptive element in nature. It responds to the intention of the one who touches it. Place the glass beside your bed and sleep normally. In the morning, observe it before anything else. If it is full of bubbles, as if it had been boiling, the energy around you was heavy. The water absorbed what was floating in your space. If it is cloudier changed, the weight was even greater. Weeks may be months of tension that was never yours. If it is clear and still, your space is light. Energy is flowing as it should. Never drink it. Pour it away. It has done its work. Wash the glass under running water. If it was not clear, repeat for seven nights. Observe the pattern. And do not fear what you find. Fear how long you have been sleeping beside it without knowing. Not all tiredness comes from the body. Sometimes you are sleeping beside what weighs you down, and you do not even know it. Write in the comments, I will do it, if you are placing a glass beside your bed tonight, and come back tomorrow to tell me what you found. And if you feel that it is not just your space that needs cleansing, but everything you carry inside. The thoughts that never stop. The tension that follows you to bed. The emotions nobody taught you how to release. I spent over twenty years learning in silence how to clear what the body carries, and train the mind to stay light. And everything I know is inside the way back to stillness. The link is in my profile.
